how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-18.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:9386:desc:0: Find and touch the bonfires located within Blackrock Spire, Dire ⟦E6⟧, Scholomance, and ⟦E7⟧, then speak with the Festival Flamekeeper.
rows.quest:86784:obj:0: Collect 6 Dry Branches and bring them to ⟦E8⟧ Shackleton.
rows.quest:86784:details:0: My associate ⟦E8⟧ Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."
rows.quest:86784:details:1: If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
rows.quest:90902:details:0: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.
rows.quest:90902:details:1: The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
rows.quest:91208:obj:0: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
rows.quest:91208:details:0: Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.
rows.quest:91208:details:1: These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
rows.quest:91209:obj:0: Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of ⟦E11⟧. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.
rows.quest:91209:details:0: Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of ⟦E11⟧ in central ⟦E12⟧. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.
rows.quest:91209:details:1: One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through ⟦E13⟧ lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
rows.quest:91282:obj:0: Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.
rows.quest:91282:details:0: It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal.
rows.quest:91282:details:1: If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
rows.quest:91285:obj:0: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
rows.quest:91285:details:0: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.
rows.quest:91285:details:1: A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
rows.quest:91294:obj:0: Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:91294:details:0: Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.
rows.quest:91294:details:1: When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.
rows.quest:91294:details:2: I'm very glad to have met you, . May the light be your guide.
rows.quest:91316:obj:0: Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in .
rows.quest:91316:details:0: This far from the ⟦E14⟧, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.
rows.quest:91316:details:1: The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
rows.quest:91317:obj:0: Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:91317:details:0: Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:91317:details:1: As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
rows.quest:91733:obj:0: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
rows.quest:91733:details:0: I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
rows.quest:91733:details:1: Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
rows.quest:91859:obj:0: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious ⟦E15⟧ travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
rows.quest:91859:details:0: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the ⟦E15⟧, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
rows.quest:91859:details:1: Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
